name: Orb of Transmutation
description: Upgrades a Normal item to a Magic item with 1 modifier

name: Greater Orb of Transmutation
description: Upgrades a Normal item to a Magic item with 1 modifier (min mod level 35)

name: Perfect Orb of Transmutation
description: Upgrades a Normal item to a Magic item with 1 modifier (min mod level 70)

name: Orb of Augmentation
description: Adds a random modifier to a Magic item

name: Greater Orb of Augmentation
description: Adds a random modifier to a Magic item (min mod level 35)

name: Perfect Orb of Augmentation
description: Adds a random modifier to a Magic item (min mod level 70)

name: Regal Orb
description: Upgrades a Magic item to a Rare item, adding 1 modifier

name: Greater Regal Orb
description: Upgrades a Magic item to a Rare item, adding 1 modifier (min mod level 35)

name: Perfect Regal Orb
description: Upgrades a Magic item to a Rare item, adding 1 modifier (min mod level 70)

name: Orb of Alchemy
description: Upgrades a Normal item to a Rare item with 4 random modifiers

name: Exalted Orb
description: Augments a Rare item with a new random modifier

name: Greater Exalted Orb
description: Augments a Rare item with a new random modifier (min mod level 35)

name: Perfect Exalted Orb
description: Augments a Rare item with a new random modifier (min mod level 50)

name: Orb of Annulment
description: Removes a random modifier from a Magic or Rare item

name: Chaos Orb
description: Removes a random modifier and adds a new random modifier to a Rare item

name: Greater Chaos Orb
description: Removes a random modifier and adds a new random modifier to a Rare item (min mod level 35)

name: Perfect Chaos Orb
description: Removes a random modifier and adds a new random modifier to a Rare item (min mod level 50)

name: Divine Orb
description: Rerolls the numeric values of the random modifiers on an item

name: Vaal Orb
description: Corrupts an item, unpredictably modifying it
